name: constraint_resource_path_child_broader_accept
description: Root grants the narrower /src/security; the child claims the broader /src. Conjunctive evaluation keeps the effective bound at the narrower parent prefix, so the request /src/security/a.go — which lies under BOTH — is authorized. A broader child prefix on the same resource cannot widen authority, but the pair is satisfiable, not unsatisfiable (SPEC §5.7.3).
